en: A black‑and‑white (sepia-toned) image showing a crowd gathered in front of a brick building with a central tower decorated with flags and bunting. People in early 20th‑century clothing watch from the ground and from a balcony draped with the Union Jack. The printed red caption in the upper right corner reads "Opening of the Mildura Public Library." The right side of the card is left blank, likely for message or address space.
